issues.title: Going Commando PAL: HUD aliases call no-C stubs and crash at startup
issues.author: Sumaiter
issues.body:
Summary
The Going Commando PAL native port crashes during startup in the title/menu path at frame 231 with a write to unmapped game address 0xCDCDCDCD.
The crash is reproducible with the verified PAL disc SCES_516.07. The log points to func_003383F0 in the HUD widget initialization.
Root cause
Several same-address alias names used by the HUD constructors have no C definition selected by hostgen, so calls are generated as empty no-c stubs:

F081de6c9_FUN_00335FC8
F36efd143_FUN_00335FC8
the…

issues.author: noire342
issues.body:
Hi! I'm working on Space Voyages, a Ratchet & Clank PAL mod. You take off normally, fly around the galaxy, use the original map to pick a waypoint, and land when you reach a planet.
